description:
DEAI is a master in development, environment and international aid taught at the Université libre de Bruxelles, preparing practitioners for NGOs, development agencies and environmental policy work. Admission runs through the ULB portal, and non-EU applicants face the earliest deadlines in the standard ULB calendar.

Programme Highlights

  • Brussels location with direct access to EU institutions and development NGOs
  • Curriculum linking environmental governance, aid effectiveness and social change
  • ULB admission portal handles both admission and scholarship documentation
  • Field-oriented projects and internship options with development organisations

Who Should Apply

Graduates in social sciences, economics, environmental studies, law or related fields; professional experience in development or humanitarian work strengthens a file considerably.

Funding and Costs

ULB and external scholarship options (including Belgian cooperation funding) are listed on the faculty's admission page. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Start with the DEAI admission page, prepare ULB's document set early, and target the non-EU application window if you need a visa. Key deadline information: ULB admission deadlines differ by applicant type (non-EU rounds open first) — check the official admission page.
